mike: quick triage: we hit a stale read in prod during demote+evict this morning.

tara: ugh. short timeline?

mike: O1 demote(epoch=305) -> accepts write W (inflight) -> slab reclaim evicts prefix -> demote completes -> O2 takes epoch=306 and serves read -> client saw pre-W state.

sasha: so demote can finish while inflight writes only live in O1 memory. that breaks post-handoff causal guarantees.

lee: options: block demote until inflight cleared; add lightweight fence metadata + soft-pin; or read-side validation against previous owner.

tara: read-side checks are messy on crashes. fence+soft-pin seems like a good first cut.

mike: sketch: old owner computes pending_digest D, publish_fence(prefix,epoch,D) to control-plane (fast metadata), best-effort flush to staging, set soft-pin to delay eviction. new owner waits T_handshake for fence; if not seen, RPC to old owner; if old owner unreachable, stall reads (safety-first).

sasha: publish_fence must be idempotent and observable. document durability modes: soft/durable/strict so tenants can trade latency vs safety.

lee: telemetry: fence_published, fence_seen, reconcile_rpc, demote_blocked, fence_latency, handoff_latency. add handoff_trace_id.

tara: tests: chaos case - demote + slab reclaim + node crash + slow writes. validate no stale reads. add to CI (non-blocking).

mike: action items:
- mike: implement fence metadata + opt-in soft-pin + unit tests + chaos scenario (ETA: EOW)
- sasha: draft control-plane fence API (ETA: 3d)
- lee: add telemetry + canary flag (ETA: 2d)
- tara: update runbook with crash-fallback (ETA: 1d)

opsbot: created ticket IR-9999: "demote-fence-softpin-mitigation"

mike: prefer blocking-by-default for strict tenants, opt-in relaxed modes later. any objections?

sasha: fine. prioritize correctness for first rollout.

tara: :thumbsup:

mike: closing thread; will post PR and link ticket.
